_comment: Health checks for a Linux host running Hermes. Each check must be able to FAIL for a real reason. Validate offline with: WATCHDOG_CONFIG=watchdogs.json python3 scripts/watchdog.py --dry-run

checks.name: hermes ticker heartbeat
checks.why: no tick means no scheduled job runs; this is the dead-man for the scheduler

checks.name: agent log fresh
checks.why: a silent agent log means the process looks healthy but is wedged or dead

checks.name: cron jobs on schedule
checks.why: a job whose next_run_at went stale fires nothing while its own last_status stays ok

checks.name: ssh service active
checks.why: on a headless host SSH is the out-of-band access path; a dead unit risks lockout

checks.name: local chat port
checks.why: backend for the local web chat; silent failure means chat is dead

checks.name: free disk
checks.why: a full disk stops writes everywhere

checks.name: available memory
checks.why: memory exhaustion OOM-kills the agent and its long-running jobs
